signature.name: Faisal Mosque
signature.detail: One of the largest mosques in the world, its striking modern design and hilltop setting make it Islamabad's most iconic sight. Visit outside prayer times, dress modestly, and remove shoes; it is a short taxi ride from the city centre.

signature.name: Pakistan Monument
signature.detail: A granite monument shaped like a blooming flower, with panoramic views over the city and a museum inside. Go late afternoon for sunset and city lights; tickets are inexpensive and it is easily reached by taxi.

signature.name: Margalla Hills
signature.detail: Forested hills offering hiking trails and viewpoints right on the city's edge. Best visited early morning or late afternoon; bring water and wear sturdy shoes, and take a taxi to the trailheads.

signature.name: Saidpur Village
signature.detail: A restored traditional village with cobbled lanes, cafes and craft shops at the foot of the Margallas. A pleasant stop for a meal or stroll; go on a weekday to avoid crowds and take a taxi.

signature.name: Rawal Lake
signature.detail: A scenic lake with a park and walking paths, popular for picnics and boating. Visit in the cooler hours; entry to the park is cheap and taxis are readily available.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing cheap; short rides $2-5
